//: Challenges (M6 phase C; game/challenge.ts): a run of `balls` fed by the practice coach (data/practice.json, the drill named), scored as `kind` says. targets: points for the first bounce of your shot inside a target on the coach's side (x across, m; depth from the net, m; r its radius, m); zone: a point for each first bounce inside the zone (x and depth ranges, m); exits: a point for each ball put out of the court after its bounce (por tres or por cuatro); won: a point for each ball the coach can't get back. medals: the scores for bronze, silver and gold. The daily challenge is one of these, picked and shifted by the date.

challenges.name: Target practice
challenges.desc: The coach feeds you groundstrokes. Land your first bounce in the rings: the corners score three, the middle two.

challenges.name: Glass vision
challenges.desc: Balls into the side glass and the corners. Read the angle off the glass and send each one back deep: the last third of their court.

challenges.name: Smash it out
challenges.desc: Short lobs over you at the net. Smash them out of the court: over the glass or out through the door, por tres or por cuatro.

challenges.name: Off the back glass
challenges.desc: Deep balls that come off your back glass. Let them come, take them as they drop, and win the point off the coach.
